titre: Housing benefits in Mayotte (ALF and ALS)
resume: Family or social housing allowance paid by the CSSM: conditions specific to Mayotte (decent housing, lived in 8 months a year), documents to prepare and applying after a separation.
aQuoiCaSert: Housing benefits reduce your rent. In Mayotte, the CSSM (Caisse de sécurité sociale de Mayotte, Mayotte's social security fund) pays the ALF (allocation de logement familiale, family housing allowance), which takes priority for households with children, or the ALS (allocation de logement sociale, social housing allowance). Only one entitlement is opened per household. After a separation, each parent who takes a home can make their own application, calculated on their new situation.
quiEstConcerne: Tenants of decent housing lived in as their main home for at least 8 months a year.
Families with dependent children, for the ALF; other people, for the ALS.
Not eligible: housing rented from a family member, or free accommodation.
aSavoir: Decency conditions applied by the CSSM: at least 9 m² for one person, 16 m² for two, plus 9 m² per additional person.
Entitlement starts the month after the application and the amount is recalculated every 3 months: apply as soon as you move in.
You apply in « Mon Compte » on caf.fr, the online account used by the CSSM.
Separation: report it. Each parent declares their own home and family situation; the amount is recalculated accordingly.

A written lease and a rent certificate signed by the landlord make the file easier. The ADIL de Mayotte (Agence départementale d'information sur le logement, the local housing information agency) can advise you free of charge if you do not have a written lease.
